user.title: Select a CTEK Battery Sense
user.description: Select the nearby battery monitor to configure.

credentials.title: Configure CTEK Battery Sense
credentials.description: Enter the Sender ID printed on the monitor or box for the device at {address}. The battery capacity is stored in Home Assistant and used for State of Charge calculation.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect. Make sure the monitor is in range and not connected to the CTEK app.
error.invalid_auth: The Sender ID did not unlock this monitor.
error.invalid_sender_id: Enter the 11-character Sender ID or full 16-character barcode.
error.not_found: The monitor is no longer in range.
error.pairing_failed: Connected to the monitor, but BLE pairing failed. Make sure the CTEK app is closed and the Bluetooth proxy supports pairing.

abort.no_connectable_devices: CTEK monitors were detected, but only by an advertisement-only Bluetooth controller. Enable active GATT connections on the nearby Bluetooth proxy or use a connection-capable Bluetooth adapter.
abort.no_devices_found: No unconfigured CTEK Battery Sense monitors were found.

init.title: CTEK Battery Sense options
init.description: Changing capacity recalculates State of Charge from the stored voltage history. The update interval controls how often Home Assistant connects while the monitor is in range.
